title: Cargo Smoke Detection Regulator — Removal
abstract: Removal of the cargo smoke detection regulator from the aft hold ceiling void, including isolation of the detection channel, capping of the sampling tubes and protection of the optical face.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove the cargo smoke detection regulator for replacement, for bench check or for access to the equipment behind it in the ceiling void.
sections.job_setup_note: The aircraft must be on the ground with the cargo hold empty. The detection channel must be isolated at the circuit breaker and the flight compartment must be told, because removing the regulator raises a detection fault that the crew will see. Get the capping plug set and the optical face cover before you start; the optical face is easily damaged and a regulator returned with a scratched face is rejected by the shop.
sections.procedure: 1. Tell the flight compartment that the aft hold detection channel will be isolated. 2. Open the applicable circuit breaker and attach the do-not-close tag. 3. Open the aft cargo door and remove the ceiling lining panel at the regulator position. 4. WARNING: SUPPORT THE LINING PANEL WHILE THE LAST FASTENERS ARE REMOVED. THE PANEL IS LARGE AND WILL FALL INTO THE HOLD. 5. Disconnect the electrical connector from the regulator and install a protective cap. 6. Disconnect the two sampling tubes at the regulator and install a capping plug in each tube immediately. 7. CAUTION: DO NOT LET ANY MOISTURE OR DEBRIS ENTER THE SAMPLING TUBES. A CONTAMINATED TUBE WILL GIVE A FALSE DETECTION AFTER INSTALLATION. 8. Hold the regulator and remove the four mounting screws. 9. Remove the regulator from the ceiling void and install the optical face cover. 10. Put the regulator in its transport container with the removal record.
sections.close_out: Leave the capping plugs and the connector cap in position until the installation task starts. Leave the circuit breaker open with the tag attached and confirm the detection fault is recorded rather than cleared. Record the removal and the regulator serial number in the aircraft technical log.

safety_precautions: Tell the flight compartment before the detection channel is isolated.
Support the ceiling lining panel while the last fasteners are removed.
